LANGUAGE REFERENCE

JoeLang 1.0

JoeLang is an object-facing language. The Studio runs the included 1.0 pack, so this short reference always describes the exact editor runtime.

Core shape

joebject Counter {
  has jint value = 0
  does add(jint amount) { value = value + amount }
}
newjoe Counter as counter
show counter.add(1)

Keywords

joebject has does newjoe as show give when otherwise joeach jin jinport input

Types and packages

jint joeble joelean jong strjin. Use jinport "std/joeraylist" as lists for typed dynamic lists, std/joemath for deterministic math, std/joetime for clock values, and std/joetext for text utilities.

The complete language-pack bundle is available through Language pack ↓ in the toolbar.
